Cards

Every card in the game: 703 monsters, 82 spells, 13 traps and 25 ritual cards. There are no levels any more and nothing is ever offered for a summon except a Toon, so what limits a deck is the limit list, and it counts ATK: 2500 ATK or more is Limited to 1 copy, 2100 or more is Semi-Limited to 2, and a few cards are held down for what they do rather than what they hit for (65 Limited, 17 Semi-Limited in all). 86 monsters are never deck cards at all - they only arrive by ritual, by fusion, by an equip or by another monster's effect, and their page says which.
